Lesson goal

Define the Indian Air and how it differs from related Superman shapes.

What it will cover

  • Definition and related shapes
  • Body-bike separation and recovery at a conceptual level

Safety

Class 3: high-consequence skills. Theory and expert references only. Any practical progression is authored and supervised in person by a verified specialist coach, in a suitable facility.

Practice only on terrain your coach has chosen, within your current skill, with the right protective equipment. Completing a lesson isn’t a safety certificate and doesn’t mean a rider is ready to try anything.
